values.name: Do not mark suppliers company name
values.description: Do not mark suppliers company name Packaging should not be marked with supplier's company name.

values.name: Mark customers company name
values.description: Mark customers company name Packaging should be marked with customer's company name.

values.name: Mark customers references
values.description: Mark customers references Packaging should be marked with customer's references.

values.name: Mark additionally customers article description
values.description: Mark additionally customers article description Packaging should also be marked with customer's article description.

values.name: Mark exclusively customers article description
values.description: Mark exclusively customers article description Packaging should be marked with customer's article description only.

values.name: Mark packages dimensions
values.description: Mark packages dimensions Packaging should be marked with package's dimensions.

values.name: Mark net weight
values.description: Mark net weight Packaging should be marked with net weight.

values.name: Mark gross weight
values.description: Mark gross weight Packaging should be marked with gross weight.

values.name: Mark tare weight
values.description: Mark tare weight Packaging should be marked with tare weight.

values.name: Mark batch number
values.description: Mark batch number Packaging should be marked with batch number.

values.name: Mark article number customer
values.description: Mark article number customer Packaging should be marked with customer's article number.

values.name: Mark running number of packages
values.description: Mark running number of packages Packaging should be marked with the running number of packages.

values.name: Mark date of production
values.description: Mark date of production Packaging should be marked with the date of production.

values.name: Mark expiry date
values.description: Mark expiry date Packaging should be marked with the expiry date.

values.name: Mark supplier number
values.description: Mark supplier number Packaging should be marked with the supplier number.

values.name: Buyer's instructions
values.description: Buyer's instructions Markings as specified by the buyer.

values.name: Seller's instructions
values.description: Seller's instructions Markings as specified by the seller.

values.name: Carrier's instructions
values.description: Carrier's instructions Markings as specified by carrier.

values.name: Legal requirements
values.description: Legal requirements Markings as specified by law.

values.name: Industry instructions
values.description: Industry instructions Markings as specified by industry.

values.name: Line item only
values.description: Line item only Exclusive reference markings for this line.

values.name: Pre-marked by buyer
values.description: Pre-marked by buyer Packaging should be pre-marked by buyer.

values.name: Entire shipment
values.description: Entire shipment Markings refer to the entire shipment.

values.name: Shipper assigned
values.description: Shipper assigned Markings to identify a shipment, package or carton as assigned by shipper.

values.name: Shipper assigned roll number
values.description: Shipper assigned roll number Markings to identify a roll as assigned by the shipper.

values.name: Shipper assigned skid number
values.description: Shipper assigned skid number Markings used to identify a skid as assigned by shipper.

values.name: Uniform Code Council (UCC) format
values.description: Uniform Code Council (UCC) format Markings according to UCC format are required. System of coding products where by each item/multipack case type is uniquely identified. A unique manufacturer Id is assigned by the UCC.

values.name: Mark free text
values.description: Mark free text Packaging should be marked with free text.

values.name: Mark case number
values.description: Mark case number Case numbers to be used for marking.

values.name: Mark serial shipping container code
values.description: Mark serial shipping container code Requests the marking of the serial shipping container code to the transport container or packaging.

values.name: Marked with ISO 10374 (permanent container tag)
values.description: Marked with ISO 10374 (permanent container tag) The container has been marked with a permanent container tag according to ISO 10374.

values.name: Mark date of packaging
values.description: Mark date of packaging Packaging must be marked with the packaging date.

values.name: Mark reference to source entity
values.description: Mark reference to source entity Packaging must be marked with the reference to source entity. The reference to source identifies that the trade item was derived from.

values.name: Marked GS1 Global Individual Asset Identifier
values.description: Marked GS1 Global Individual Asset Identifier Indication that the GS1 Global Individual Asset Identifier has been marked on the package.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
